page.layout: Two oval portrait medallions centred at the top, one on the left and one on the right. Below them one column of running text. Page number at top right, running head at top centre. Signature at the foot on the right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: HYRCANUS Iamnei filius post matrem Alexandram
apud Iudæos regnat non ita diu, nam frater eius Aristobulus
minor natu, eum fugat: convenit tandem inter ipsos ut Hyr-
canus privatum, Aristobulus Regem vivat. verum post an.6.à
Pompeio Hyrcanus restituitur: & partim solus, partim cum
Antipatro Herodis patre, administrat:tandē ei aures dentibus
præcidit Antigonus.Iose.lib.14.ca.1.& 22.

page.notes: Two medallion portraits, both with inscriptions around the rim, not transcribed as text. Left medallion: "8 D. IVD." on the left rim and "II HIRCANVS" on the right rim. Right medallion: "9 D. IVDEOR." on the left rim and "II ARISTOBOLVS" on the right rim. Spaced capitals at the start of each entry (HYRCANUS, ARISTOBULUS) are set as the lead-in of a paragraph, so they are kept inside the paragraph, not as headings. Their V's are read as U as they are vowels. No doubtful readings in the text.
